bullets: Own product strategy and execution for one or more mission-critical software products, from discovery through delivery and iteration.
Develop deep empathy for users by conducting customer interviews, observing workflows, and partnering closely with domain experts to understand complex operational challenges.
Quickly ramp into unfamiliar technical domains and synthesize complex concepts into clear product direction.
Define product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics aligned with customer outcomes and company objectives.
Translate user needs, technical capabilities, and business priorities into clear product requirements and well-defined initiatives.
